tweets.text: United Launch Alliance ( a joint venture between Boeing $BA and Lockheed Martin $LMT ) is raising $1.5 billion through a private bond offering. That’s 3x the initially planned $500 million. ULA conducts launch missions for the U.S. military and commercial customers, including Amazon. #BA #LMT

$NOK is effectively pulling out of mainland China. By the end of 2026, it plans to close nearly all of its facilities and significantly reduce its local workforce. The company says its business in the region has been declining for years and that it is downsizing its operational footprint accordingly. China now accounts for only a very small share of total revenue. #NOK

Northland upgraded $ALAB to Outperform with a $350 price target. Analyst Gus Richard: “We expect earnings revisions to become more positive and the AI infrastructure spending cycle to last longer than anticipated.” Content per rack will continue to increase, while ALAB is expected to gain share in scale-up/scale-out switching and signal conditioning. New major funding commitments ($200B Anthropic + $500B Nvidia partnerships) could push the peak of spending out to 2027. ALAB is expected to remain one of the fastest-growing companies in AI infrastructure chips. #ALAB

$UBER is scaling up drone delivery by investing in Zipline. The goal: 1 million drone deliveries per day by the end of 2029. The CEO expects drones to become a meaningful growth driver for Uber Eats by enabling faster deliveries over longer distances. Another step forward in autonomous logistics.

$RKLB has taken another step forward on the national security front. Viasat selected Rocket Lab’s Lightning-GEO platform for the U.S. Space Force’s anti-jam (PTS-G) satellite. Peter Beck: “This award reflects our growing role in national security space. We’re moving from the design phase into production.” The fact that the same Lightning bus is being reused across different programs, along with the strengthening Space Systems backlog, is particularly noteworthy.

$NOW • AI ACV has surpassed $1 billion, while agentic AI has grown 9x. • 20%+ revenue growth and a 98–99% renewal rate point to strong and highly predictable revenue. • The CEO made a personal stock purchase, while Jensen Huang describes the company as an “enterprise AI OS.” • Forward valuation is currently at historically attractive levels. And now, the technical setup is adding to the story: the stock appears to be on the verge of a major breakout. Strong fundamentals, an attractive valuation, and a technical setup that looks ready.

Deutsche Bank $ASTS Model Summary (2030E): 320 cumulative commercial satellites 65.4 million supplemental coverage subscribers ~180 million Day Pass users 25 million primary broadband subscribers Total revenue: $4.47 billion Adj. EBITDA: $3.60 billion (80%+ margin) FCF: $864 million The key takeaway: The bottleneck isn’t demand or production — it’s launch capacity. With 60+ MNO partners and a potential subscriber base of 3 billion, the model assumes only a 2% conversion rate. Even that looks like a conservative scenario. #ASTS
